title: A limit that is affine over the base is affine over the base at a finite stage
statement: Let $T$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set and $(Z_i)_{i\in I}$ an inverse system of schemes over $T$, with structure morphisms $h_i:Z_i\to T$ (so $h_i\circ f_{i'i}=h_{i'}$ for the transition morphisms $f_{i'i}:Z_{i'}\to Z_i$, $i'\ge i$), whose transition morphisms are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism]; let $Z=\varprojlim_iZ_i$ be its limit in the category of schemes [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition], with projections $p_i:Z\to Z_i$ and $h=h_i\circ p_i:Z\to T$ the induced morphism. Assume every $Z_i$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated and $h$ is affine. Then there is $i_0\in I$ such that $h_i:Z_i\to T$ is affine for every $i\ge i_0$ (Stacks Limits, Lemma 09ZM).

proof.text: Fix b in the nonempty index category I^op and take the finite subcover of T.affineCover. Its ranges V_a are affine opens and their supremum is top. The finite index type may be empty.

For each V_a put U_a = h_b^{-1}(V_a). The map h_b is quasi-compact since its source is compact and its target is quasi-separated (quasiCompact_of_compactSpace). Thus U_a is compact by QuasiCompact.isCompact_preimage. For every k in Over b, the open D(k.hom)^{-1}(U_a) is compact because the transition is affine, hence quasi-compact, and it is quasi-separated because it is an open of the quasi-separated scheme D(k.left). This uses the topological isQuasiSeparated_iff_quasiSeparatedSpace and IsQuasiSeparated.of_quasiSeparatedSpace, rather than a base-change description of h_b restricted to V_a.

Use opensDiagram D b U_a and opensCone D c b U_a. Mathlib isLimitOpensCone gives the restricted limit and the opensDiagram instance gives affine transitions. Its point c.pi_b^{-1}(U_a) equals f^{-1}(V_a) by compatibility _hf b, so it is affine since f is affine. Apply Scheme.exists_isAffine_of_isLimit to choose k_a in Over b with affine D(k_a.hom)^{-1}(U_a). Naturality of h identifies this open with h_{k_a.left}^{-1}(V_a).

Use IsCofiltered.inf_objs_exists on the finite set of k_a.left to choose i with arrows gi_a : i -> k_a.left. For any j >= i.unop the preorder supplies g : op j -> i. Pulling the affine open h_{k_a.left}^{-1}(V_a) back along the affine transition D(g followed by gi_a) gives an affine open; naturality identifies it with h_{op j}^{-1}(V_a). HasAffineProperty.of_iSup_eq_top applied to the finite affine cover proves IsAffineHom(h_{op j}). If the cover is empty, inf_objs_exists still supplies i by nonemptiness and the local criterion applies vacuously.

split_report.summary: Statement checked against Limits 09ZM (limits.tex lines 891-901) and kept; stmt_deps kept. Proof written in five steps following the Stacks proof (lines 902-911), on the model of the reviewed sibling lem-weil-pbc-descend-affine (01ZN): (1) a fixed index 0, I_{>=0} directed, a finite affine open covering V_1..V_n of T; (2) W_{j,i}=h_i^{-1}(V_j)=f_{i0}^{-1}(W_{j,0}), W_j=h^{-1}(V_j)=p_0^{-1}(W_{j,0}), W_j affine, W_{j,i} quasi-compact and quasi-separated (needed for 01Z6, which the source does not check); (3) W_j = lim_{i>=0} W_{j,i} with affine transition maps from Limits 01YX(2) (lem-weil-pbc-limit-cone-affine-projections-opens), which the source states without reference; (4) 01Z6 (lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-stage, Mathlib leaf Scheme.exists_isAffine_of_isLimit) for each j; (5) a common index by directedness and Morphisms 01S8 (pqf-lem-affine-local-target). No new node: every step uses existing nodes (01Z6 and 01S8 already have nodes; the restriction of the limit to an open is clause (2) of the 01YX node). Tags verified in literature/stacks-project/tags/tags: 09ZM, 01Z6, 01S8, 01YX.
